title: freetokens offer detail document
description: Strict schema for offers/details/<slug>.json. One optional JSON document per offer slug extending the summary card with a description, how-to-claim steps, and social proof. Every claim must be evidence-backed; never guess.

summary.description: Detailed offer description shown in the detail card, beyond the list-card amount line.

claim_steps.description: Ordered how-to-claim instructions rendered as an ordered list.

type.description: Evidence kind. x/reddit/link require url; screenshot requires a site-relative image path.

url.description: Link to the post or source (required except for screenshots).

author.description: Post author display name (x and reddit).

text.description: Short quoted excerpt of the post (x, reddit, link).

image.description: Site-relative path of a committed screenshot asset (screenshot).
